name: Caitlyn
description: Voice set for Arctic Warfare Caitlyn (skin 4): a sniper on the Arctic front, where the cold is unforgiving and the winds are harsh, with deadly aim and a killer instinct. Tundra, whiteouts, patience, frost and the last shot before the storm. Builds on caitlyn-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} down. A blizzard against us. Bring warmth, and votes.
Thirty or more behind. Send word across the tundra. Every outpost.
{momentTitle} trails by {voteDiff}. Signal anyone within range of a radio.
Fifteen-odd short. A cold patch. It will pass.
Down {voteDiff}. Bring company. Nobody should freeze out here alone.
{voteDiff} behind. A few patient shots, and the wind changes.
Down {voteDiff}. A small drift. Clear it before the next squall.
Dead level. One breath, one shot, one vote. Make it count.
One vote apart. Stop crouching in the snow and fire.
{voteDiff} votes apart. The ice is holding by a thread. Bring more.
{voteDiff} votes between them. The wind decides at the last.
{momentTitle} holds {userPct}%. A clear sight line. Keep your hands steady.
{userPct}% and climbing. Don't let the cold get to you.
{userPct}%. A good position in poor weather. Stay patient.
{userPct}% behind your pick. We hold the ridge. Keep it.
Up at {userPct}%. Good. Breathe out. Finish it.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and has taken the lead. A thaw at exactly the right moment.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. It turned like the wind.
Climbed out of a {voteDiff} drift. Impressive in this cold.
{momentTitle} was buried. Now it stands above the snow.
{momentTitle} has pulled ahead. The ice cracked in our favour.

messages: {username} voted with you on {momentTitle}. Two shooters, one target.
{username} chose {momentTitle} as well. A steady eye in this weather.
{username} agrees with you. Warmth is where you find it.
Same pick as {username}. A welcome ally in the white.
{username} stood with {momentTitle}. Well spotted.
{username} reached the same view. A sound read of the wind.
{username} is on your side of {momentTitle}. Share the fire.
{username} made the same call. No radio needed.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Welcome to the outpost.
details: Good eyes are rare in a blizzard.
Pleasant, having company in the cold.

messages: {username} voted {theirMoment} against {yourMoment}. A different shot. Let's see whose lands.
{username} picked {theirMoment}. Different target. Different wind.
{username} went the other way on {yourMoment}. Mistaken, but patient about it.
{username} voted against you. I respect a steady rival.
{username} took {theirMoment}. A bold shot. Possibly a miss.
{username} opposes {yourMoment}. Very well. The count will tell.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. Let the snow settle.
{username} voted the other way. They'll see differently once it clears.
details: A polite disagreement. In the cold.
The tally has the last word.
A rival keeps the aim sharp.
At least it's a fair fight.

messages: Ten in a row with {username}. That isn't chance, that's long-range chemistry.
{username} and you, ten matches, the same call each time. Perfectly in step.
Ten straight with {username}. I'd share a hide with you.
A ten-match run with {username}. Not a single miss in the snow.
Ten for ten with {username}. Remarkable. I'm nearly warm.
details: Rare in this cold. Look after it.

messages: {streakCount} matches with {username}. No longer a pair, now a whole outpost.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I'd follow you both across any ice.
{streakCount} matching picks with {username}. Scarcely believable.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. The kind they tell by the fire.
{streakCount} with {username}. Not one miss. Either of you.
details: That's trust, forged in the cold.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. A standoff, frozen solid.
{username} has opposed you ten times running. Both of you are made of ice.
Ten in a row opposite {username}. Neither will blink.
A ten-match run against {username}. Stubborn as permafrost.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I'd watch that from a safe ridge.
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's an ice age.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you gives up a single drift.
{streakCount} straight disagreements with {username}. Frozen doesn't cover it.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Someone should light a fire between you.
{streakCount} against {username}. I admire the endurance. Do come inside.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and you haven't taken your shot. There's time.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your vote is missing from the snow.
{matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft}. I'd like your vote on this one.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. The weather's turning. Move.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me come and dig you out.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. You've gone very still.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. The storm is almost here.
{timeLeft} left. Breathe out. Fire.
Last light on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Squeeze gently.
{matchCount} matches missing your vote will shut soon. The first has {timeLeft} remaining.
{matchCount} unvoted matches and the sky is darkening. The nearest ends in {timeLeft}.
No votes on {matchTitle}. Someone must leave the first tracks.
{moment1} against {moment2} and not a single shot. I'll wait. Briefly.
A new match, untouched snow. Be first across it.
{matchTitle} is unmarked. Take the first shot.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new targets in the white.
{matchCount} matches have opened in round {round}. The thaw begins.
Round {round} is live, with {matchCount} targets to scope.
A new round. {matchCount} matches. Find your shots.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches awaiting your aim.
{momentTitle} won. Clean through the snow.
{momentTitle} is through. A fine shot.
{momentTitle} won it. Rightly so.
{momentTitle} won, and without a flinch.
{momentTitle} advances. One target down.
{momentTitle} moves on. Steady hands.
details: One down, more in the white.

messages: {momentTitle} lost. A cold result.
{momentTitle} is out. Not the outcome I'd aimed for.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Pull your collar up.
{momentTitle} went down standing. That counts.
{momentTitle} is out. Warm your hands. Return.
{momentTitle} lost this round. A hard frost. Not winter.
{momentTitle} was eliminated. More targets lie ahead.
details: It held out to the end.

messages: Welcome to the tundra. {liveCount} matches are open. Choose one.
A new arrival. {liveCount} matches are live. Come in from the cold.
You're ahead of the thaw. {liveCount} matches need a decision.
{liveCount} matches are open. Pick your side of the ridge.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Mind the ice.
Day two. You came back through the snow. Good.
Two days in a row. Heartening.
A second day out in the cold. I noticed.
{days} days away. I'd feared the cold had taken you.
After {days} days you return. Better late than buried.
{days} days. I'd begun to think the snow had claimed you. I'm glad it hadn't.
{days} days away. The drifts have shifted.
You're back. Good.
Welcome back. Let's get to work.
Back already. Steady.
Ah. There you are.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. A very quiet tundra.
Few shooters out here. That should change.
Low turnout. The cold keeps them indoors. Come out anyway.
Hardly anyone's taken a look. Someone should.
details: Every shot counts in empty country.
Yours counts for more on this stretch.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you haven't voted. The deciding shot is yours.
Dead level on {matchTitle}. A single shot breaks the ice.
A tie. Someone must fire. Let it be you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, frozen in place. Choose.
Still tied and the weather is closing in. One last shot.
Level, with the storm arriving. Vote.
Tied, and almost out of time. Please don't leave it frozen.
Still deliberating? The wind won't wait forever.
Don't dwell on it. Choose and hold your aim.
Each deserves a look through the scope. Trust your eye.
You've watched from the ridge long enough. Descend.
details: No wrong target. Only costly ones.

messages: First shot taken. Welcome to the cold.
You chose a target. A fine start.
details: The first of many, I think. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes. You're finding your range in the wind.
Five. No longer a stranger to the snow.
Ten votes. The outpost knows your boots.
Ten. You've earned a spot by the fire.
Twenty-five votes. Your voice carries across the ice.
Twenty-five. The tundra is listening.
details: Twenty-five shots down the range. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty votes. Well into the white.
Fifty. You clearly care. That keeps a person warm.
A hundred votes. They'll tell tales about it in the barracks.
One hundred. Remarkable. I'll say it only once.
details: A hundred. Stand against the wind. +{xp} XP

messages: Three days running. A fire catches.
Three days on the ridge. Dependable.
details: Turning up is the hard part. +{xp} XP

messages: A full week. That's endurance.
Seven days running. Hardy.
details: A week without a gap in the watch. +{xp} XP
Seven mornings in the cold. +{xp} XP

messages: A fortnight. You've never left the ridge.
A fortnight in the snow. Extraordinary.
details: A fortnight at the ridge. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days. Thank you. I mean it.
A month at your post. That says a great deal.
details: Thirty days of frost and grit. +{xp} XP
A full month in the freeze. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You favour what the cold forgot.
Five unlikely picks. I like that.
Fifteen underdogs. You walk into the wind deliberately.
Fifteen. You answer to nobody's weather report.
details: Fifteen votes against the gale. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs. No scout can read your tracks.
Thirty. The long shot is your whole discipline.
details: Thirty votes for the one lagging. +{xp} XP

messages: First on the ridge five times. Quick off the mark.
Five times you beat the others to the hide.
details: You arrive before the sun. +{xp} XP
Five votes before the rest. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where you led the way. Decisive.
Always first out into the snow.
details: Fifteen votes ahead of the pack. +{xp} XP
Ahead of the whole patrol. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. You keep your hands warm under pressure.
Another narrow one. Your nerve is frozen steel.
Twenty-five close matches. Your vote keeps tipping the ice.
You've cracked more than one freeze.
details: Twenty-five finishes by a whisker. +{xp} XP

messages: Five times you held with the one behind. Stubborn. Approved.
You never leave a side stuck in a drift. Honourable.
details: Faith in a late thaw. +{xp} XP
Five turnarounds you read early. +{xp} XP

messages: Same moment, three times. Someone has a favourite hide.
That one again? It must be a good view.
Five votes for the same moment. That's staying power.
You won't leave that one. I understand.
Ten shots at the same moment. That's fixation.
Ten times, the same target. I won't comment. Much.
Two rounds. You're holding your bearing.
Round two and still out here. Good.
Four rounds. Deep into the whiteout.
Deep in the bracket. The wind grows harsher now.
details: Far from the first camp. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You crossed the whole tundra.
All the way. You never turned back.
details: First flake to final shot. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You've covered a lot of ice.
Ten different matches. Thorough scouting. Good.
Twenty-five matches. You've seen every valley.
Twenty-five. Not a drift left unchecked.
Fifty matches. That isn't a visit, that's a winter posting.
Fifty. You know this bracket better than the maps do.
details: A true veteran of the cold. +{xp} XP

messages: Five without a pause. A long cold watch.
Five back to back. Do warm your hands.
Ten in one go. A hard stretch of cold.
Ten in one sitting. That's hardiness.
Voting at this hour? On watch, or just sleepless?
The dead of the night. Duty, or restlessness. I know both.
details: The long polar night suits you. +{xp} XP
A vote in the dark. +{xp} XP

messages: You told others. Thank you.
Five shares. More shooters, more strength.
Fifteen shares. You're practically a radio operator.
Fifteen. You keep calling them in from the cold. Splendid.
You were here before the first thaw. A founding member, always.
One of the first thousand. That can't be erased.
details: That is yours to keep. +{xp} XP
No one takes that from you. +{xp} XP

messages: A new rank. Hard-earned.
Promoted. Wear it lightly.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Bravely won.
Another mark for the logbook: {name}.
{rank}. Entirely deserved.
You've put in the cold hours and it shows.
Ten underdogs. Reckless. I know the type.
Ten long shots. Not easily chilled.
details: Ten shots against the odds. +{xp} XP
Impossible distances are your speciality. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones. You share my steady hands.
Ten tight finishes. I'm privately pleased.
details: Steady aim in a bitter wind. +{xp} XP

messages: Seven days straight. A true eye.
Seven days, not a miss. Well shot.
details: A week of cold precision. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie. One breath, one shot.
A frozen stalemate, and you cracked it. Splendid.
details: The shot that decided it. +{xp} XP

messages: Caitlyn, in position. Stay low and keep warm.
Caitlyn is yours now. Do try to keep up in this cold.

upcoming: Not open yet. Wait for the weather to clear.
Voting isn't open yet. I'll flash a signal when it is.
Not yet. Patience is half of marksmanship.
prevote: Two edits and one shot. Scope them both first.
Observe them both before you commit. No guessing in this wind.
I'll keep my preference to myself. The shot is yours.
Take your time. A steady shot beats a fast one.
Choose the one you can stand behind.
prevote-empty: No votes yet. Leave the first tracks.
Quiet so far. Someone has to break the hush.
Not one shot fired. Make the first.
closing-24h: Under a day left and no vote from you. Move.
closing-3h: Time is short. Vote before the storm.
voted-early: You voted early with hardly anyone here. First in the snow.
Hardly a vote in the snow and you'd already chosen. Firm.
voted-ahead: Your pick is ahead. Good. The weather can still turn.
A lead is a lead. Stay low.
voted-close: Razor-thin. One more vote tips it. Send a signal.
Dead heat. Your pick wants an ally.
voted-tied: Perfectly level. Neither holds the ridge.
Dead level in the snow. Frustrating. Quite thrilling.
voted-behind: You're trailing. That alone doesn't make you wrong.
{pick} is lagging. An underdog. I've been there.
They lead. You aren't wrong, only outnumbered.
Trailing by {diff} points. Signal everyone you can reach.
Most went the other way. Crowds misjudge wind.
closed-won: Your pick won. A sound call.
{pick} went through. You read the wind rightly.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. A pity. It was a decent target.
It fell short. The cold takes some. Carry on.
closed-tied: A draw. Neither side lost a foot of snow.
closed-unvoted: The window shut and you missed this one. Others will come.
The match is over. {winner} took it. Next time, shoot sooner.

first-vote: Your first vote. Welcome. Nobody's first shot is steady.
That's your first shot. It steadies. I assure you.
You're one of the outpost now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days on the ridge. I see you keeping watch.
You keep coming back to the ridge. I value that.
underdog: You chose the one nobody else would. I noticed.
A hard choice. A good one.
The trailing side. That takes some nerve.
early: Early. You reached the ridge before the rest.
Little traffic so far. Your shot would be noticed.
First to reach the ridge. Well done.
close: That vote moved the ice. It's balanced finely.
A sliver. One more vote turns it.
A near thing. Your vote could tip the ice.
behind: {pick} is trailing. Trailing isn't dead. Send for help.
Not ahead yet. Still ground to cross.
Behind, not buried. There's a difference.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't ease off. The wind shifts.
In front for the moment. Don't trust it.
default: Your vote is logged. There's more country to cover.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and not a shot yet. Begin with the one you read best.
Every target is in sight. Choose. I won't hurry you.
{unvoted} remaining. No pressure. A little, maybe.
live-some: {voted} fired, {unvoted} still to go. Keep walking.
A fair beginning. The drifts won't shift themselves.
live-few: {unvoted} left. Finish before the light fades.
live-one: One match left in the snow. Don't abandon it.
A single match between you and a clean sweep of the snow.
live-closing: A few shut within {timeLeft}. {unvoted} are still waiting on you.
Time is thinning. {unvoted} left, {timeLeft} to go.
The storm is coming. Do hurry.
live-done: Every match covered. Well done. Survey the bracket.
Your list is clear. Come back when the next round opens.
Every match cleared. Uncommon. Well done.
live-none: No match is live right now. It will come back. Study the bracket while it's quiet.
Quiet across the ice. Check back soon.
No matches open. I'm as stiff with waiting as you.
brackets-groups: Groups are first. Two per group cross over. The remainder stay in the snow.
All start in a group. Few cross the ice beyond it.
Mind the standings. They drift fast.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts approach. Two from each group make the crossing.
No knockout stage yet. The groups are still out in the snow.
Be patient. The knockout thaws out once the groups end.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts are live. Lose once and you're left in the cold.
One loss ends it. The cold gives no second tries.
Each match is colder now. Choose wisely.
brackets-bracket: Stage by stage. Lose once and it's over.
Trace the bracket. It narrows with every freeze.
Each line here is a match that someone sighted.
brackets-complete: The cup is complete. Thank you for braving the cold with me.
It's done. A hard season. I'll miss the quiet.
We have a champion. A fitting end to the season.
brackets-empty: No bracket on the map. Nothing has been charted.
Blank snow. The draw hasn't been made yet.
Bare snow for now. Look in again later.

invite: {a} or {b}. A single shot decides it. Choose.
{a} against {b}: two edits, one shot. Take it.
{a} versus {b}. Join the watch and give me your view.
voted: My shot goes to {pick} over {other}. Where's yours?
{pick} gets my shot over {other}. Convince me otherwise.
I picked {pick} over {other}. Would you shoot differently?
early: Among the first shots for {pick} against {other}. More are needed.
I called {pick} over {other} early. Add your shot.
{pick} against {other}, barely a shot fired. Yours would matter.
tied: {pick} and {other} are even. One shot ends it.
{pick} and {other} are frozen level. Break the ice.
{pick} and {other} are frozen together. Your shot can split them.
nailbiter: {voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. Every one counts.
{voteDiff} votes lie between {pick} and {other}. Fire yours.
{voteDiff} separate {pick} and {other}. The wind could favour either.
losing-close: {voteDiff} divide {pick} from {other}. A few shots flip it.
{pick} sits {voteDiff} under {other}, still fighting. Lend it your vote.
{pick} is {voteDiff} short of {other}. Still recoverable. Vote.
losing-bad: {other} leads {pick} by {voteDiff}. It needs a vote or two.
{voteDiff} adrift of {other}. {pick} deserves better weather. Vote.
{other} has {pick} down by {voteDiff}. Let's thaw this.
winning-close: {pick} has {pct}% over {other}, narrowly. Help it hold the ridge.
{pick} is up on {other}, {pct}%. Not safe yet. Vote.
dominating: {pick} leads {other} on {pct}%. Come and see what the fuss is.
{pick} holds {pct}%. {other} is lost in the drift.
{pick} is far ahead of {other}, {pct}%. Add your shot.
